title: NO REPEATS OF THE GUN CARD
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD and never repeats what is already on screen. A reload said Reloading and then Reloaded, an empty gun said Out of ammo, a swap said the gun name, and a belt key said the item and its count. The gun card already shows RELOADING and the gun in hand, the crosshair shows R RELOAD and NO AMMO, and the belt shows the key and its count, so those lines are gone. Every sound stays.
now: Reloading, swapping guns and picking a belt key no longer put lines in the feed; the gun card and the crosshair show it.
